summary: We will be performing an unscheduled maintenance starting on Thursday, October 8, 2026 at 7:00 AM PDT (10:00 AM EDT / 4:00 PM CEST / 1:00 AM AEDT October 9).
body:
[Updated 10/8 at 8:25 AM PDT] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 2 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to ensure you receive the latest client update.

We will be performing an unscheduled maintenance starting on Thursday, October 8, 2026 at 7:00 AM PDT (10:00 AM EDT / 4:00 PM CEST / 1:00 AM AEDT October 9). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 2 hours, concluding around 9:00 AM PDT (12:00 PM EDT / 6:00 PM CEST / 3:00 AM AEDT October 9).

Times:

Thursday, October 8, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 7:00 AM - 9:00 AM
EDT (UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +10): 1:00 AM October 9 - 3:00 AM October 9

What will be unavailable:

  • All MapleStory Classic World game servers.

Changes and Updates:

  • [Updated 10/8/2026] Decreased the selling price of Coconut from 145 Mesos → 10 Mesos.
  • Resolved an issue where the effective healing distance of Cleric's Heal skill was wider than intended.
  • Resolved an issue where Cleric's Heal skill could still be used without enough MP.
  • Resolved an issue where some players were unable to connect to Channels 1, 2, 3, and 4.
name: [Completed] Unscheduled Maintenance - October 8, 2026
